title: Database contention interrupts corner updates and account deletion
whatHappens: Database contention interrupts corner updates and account deletion

observations.text: Sentry, 3-4 Nov: 12 issues (lock timeouts, deadlocks, connect timeouts), 1-3 events each, 0 users, spread from 12:49 to 10:06 UTC. Log walk: 270 skill-anchor lock timeouts, 17 Sentry-wake and 14 check re-read failures; about 72,000 slow-query lines, mostly one agent command recovery query.

Five unresolved groups total 22 events in the last day. The latest corner refresh failed on the delivered release. Three paths already have an approved repair; connection-pool pressure remains untraced.
